description.zh_CN: 按来源 IP 汇总代理流量，支持 AnyTLS、VLESS、VMess、Trojan、Shadowsocks、Hysteria、TUIC 等协议，显示地区、在线状态、疑似设备、目标站点和每个 IP 的域名明细。
description.en: Aggregates proxy traffic by source IP for AnyTLS, VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria, TUIC and more, with region, online state, inferred devices, target sites, and per-IP domain details.
